source.attribution: Fresh isolated cp_16 English T.1 run; all four service display checkpoints passed. Synthetic VPX-derived motor feedback stops before step7; lower button112 and114 are then held at1 to stabilize PinMAME automatic lower EOS111/113. Upper116raw1 shows UR FLIPPER BUT / LAST SW F6; raw0 clears its caption; repeat1 restores it. Upper118raw1 shows UL FLIPPER BUT / LAST SW F8; raw0 clears; repeat1 restores. Native DMD snapshots9-14 visually inspected. Direct public readback is host stimulus only. This proves ROM reachability and active levels under these conditions, not fitted upper flippers or physical contacts.
